##: Portable zip preferred over the Inno Setup installer: the installer writes registry file associations for .blick, which scoop cannot clean up.
description: Fully native non-linear video editor built from scratch. Scrub, cut, and keyframe with fast feedback; available as a free public beta for Windows.
notes: Free beta cannot open project files; a license key from https://blickeditor.com/pricing is required for that.
